d: The Business Development Manager- Services is responsible for driving new business growth by identifying, engaging, and converting new logos and new partners into clients across Arabic.AI Group's Enterprise Services portfolio, spanning Tarjama LSP, Content Lab, and Ureed.

The role is a hunter-focused business development position, responsible for proactively prospecting assigned target accounts, understanding their business and language-service requirements, identifying opportunities, developing tailored approaches, and driving opportunities through to successful closure.

The position requires a highly driven and resilient individual who thrives in a target-oriented environment, can operate effectively under pressure and ambiguity, and is motivated by winning new business. The role will also leverage strategic partnerships and internal stakeholders where appropriate to accelerate market access and deal closure.

The role covers the UAE market and spans three service lines sold consultatively and in combination rather than as siloed, single-product pitches: LSP (Editorial Translation, Media Translation- subtitling, dubbing, video editing, Staffing, Data Services), Ureed Secondments (Tech and Linguist placements), and Content Lab (Events, Talent Sourcing, Social Media Management, Strategy, Tech, Design/Branding, and Content).
Own the acquisition of new logos within assigned markets, segments, and accounts.
Develop and execute account-specific approaches to penetrate target organizations and establish new commercial relationships.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified prospects and opportunities.
Consistently work toward and achieve assigned business development and revenue targets.
Identify decision-makers, influencers, buying centers, and potential entry points within target organizations.
Apply structured, disciplined opportunity qualification (e.g., MEDDPICC or equivalent), qualifying in and disqualifying out target accounts and opportunities with equal rigor.
Take full ownership of assigned target accounts and conduct comprehensive A-Z account research.
Develop a strong understanding of each target account, including:
Potential business pain points and opportunities
Translate assigned accounts into actionable accounts penetration and go-to-market strategies.
Identify where the company's LSP, Ureed Secondments, and Content Lab portfolio can create measurable value for each target account.
Build and maintain account plans and stakeholder maps for a defined target account list.
Conduct proactive outbound prospecting through multiple channels, including physical meetings, calls, email, LinkedIn, networking, events, referrals, and industry connections.
Generate new meetings and business opportunities through structured and persistent prospecting.
Qualify opportunities based on business need, commercial potential, buying authority, timing, and fit.
Maintain consistent prospecting activity and pipeline generation.
Generate and co-develop pipeline together with Marketing through account-based marketing (ABM) efforts.
Generate and manage pipeline in partnership with the company's channel and partner ecosystem.
Understand client requirements and position relevant LSP, Ureed Secondments, or Content Lab services accordingly.
Develop compelling commercial propositions, proposals, and presentations in collaboration with relevant internal teams.
Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, and deal progression.
Own opportunities from initial prospecting through qualification, proposal, negotiation, and closure.
Close deals directly or indirectly through strategic partnerships and channel relationships.
Leverage partnerships to access new markets, accounts, and opportunities.
Identify opportunities to expand the scope of an initial engagement into broader LSP service offerings.
Respond to and win structured bids/RFPs, particularly government-driven, while building deliberate repeat-cadence pipeline rather than relying on one-off project wins.
Define and articulate quantified ROI/business cases for prospective clients.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of prospects, activities, opportunities, and deal stages in the CRM.
Provide regular visibility on pipeline value, forecast, conversion rates, activities, and expected closures.
Ensure disciplined follow-up and progression of opportunities.
Analyze pipeline performance and continuously improve prospecting and conversion approaches.
Support win-back efforts on lapsed or lost accounts as a distinct, tracked motion.
Work closely with the Production, Marketing and other relevant functions to ensure commercial commitments are realistic and deliverable.
Coordinate internally to develop customized solutions and proposals for prospects.
Ensure a smooth transition from closed opportunity to implementation and account ownership.
Attend industry conferences and events in the industry to promote the organization and network with potential clients and partners.
Lead prospecting at industry exhibitions and events, including job fairs relevant to staffing and secondments, using a pre-built target list.
Develop and maintain client relationships, expectations & satisfaction.
Conduct regular in-person meetings with clients and stakeholders in the local market to strengthen relationships.
q: A bachelor’s degree in business management or any related field is preferable.

At least 8 years of proven experience in business development, new business sales, or hunting roles. Background in multi-product/portfolio selling (e.g., agency, staffing, LSP, or professional services environments) is a strong advantage; a consulting background is a plus.
A good understanding of Language and Translation services and the challenges faced within the specific market sectors.
Previous experience working within an agency environment is highly preferred, particularly within language services, localization, media, creative, marketing, content, or related B2B services.
Demonstrated track record of acquiring new clients and closing B2B deals.
Experience managing a defined target-account list and developing account penetration strategies.
Excellent prospecting, networking, negotiation, and closing skills.

Excellent account research and business intelligence skills.
Ability to understand client needs and translate them into relevant LSP solutions.

Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.

Resilient, persistent, and able to handle rejection and setbacks.
Excellent level of proficiency with MS Office Project, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
Excellent command of both spoken and written English.
Willingness to travel approximately 25–50% to UAE, typically involving one to two business trips per month, depending on business requirements.

d: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

We are building a suite of tokenized equity capital markets products from the ground up, and are looking for a Research Analyst to join a small, high-impact team. This is a 0-to-1 opportunity for a self-starter who wants to help shape products from inception through launch.

The analyst will support the full product lifecycle — conducting due diligence on issuers, companies, vendors, and partners; building commercial and economic models; and producing the research, memos, and analysis that underpin key commercial decisions. The role is highly cross-functional, working closely with internal stakeholders in a fast-moving environment where initiative and ownership are essential.
q: Minimum 4 years of relevant experience, ideally within equity capital markets (ECM), or investment banking at a bank, advisory firm, or comparable institution.
Solid understanding of the equity capital markets and the mechanics of public and private capital raises (e.g. IPOs, follow-on offerings).
Strong financial modeling and quantitative analysis skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to produce polished, institutional-quality memos and presentations for senior stakeholders.
A genuine self-starter — comfortable with ambiguity, taking initiative, and building processes where none exist.
Strong attention to detail, sound commercial judgment, and the ability to operate under deadline pressure.
Familiarity with digital assets, tokenization, or a clear appetite to build expertise in bringing equity capital markets on-chain.
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

r: Conduct thorough due diligence on prospective issuers, companies, vendors, partners, and counterparties, presenting findings in clear, decision-ready formats.
Perform fundamental analysis and build commercial and financial models to evaluate product structures, pricing, allocation, deal economics, and profitability.
Conduct competitor and market research across the capital markets landscape, benchmarking products, platforms, and market participants to inform positioning and strategy.
Prepare internal committee memos, decision documents, and management presentations that translate complex analysis into concise, actionable recommendations.
Track developments across the equity capital markets — pipeline, follow-on and related equity offerings, and broader market conditions — surfacing risks and opportunities proactively.
Support the transaction and product lifecycle, taking ownership of workstreams from research through to execution.

d: We are seeking detail-oriented and finance-focused professionals for the positions of Tax Specialist / VAT Specialist. These roles focus on tax compliance, value-added tax (VAT) administration, tax reporting, regulatory interpretation, and the effective management of organizational tax obligations. The ideal candidates should demonstrate strong knowledge of taxation principles, analytical thinking, financial accuracy, and an understanding of applicable tax regulations and compliance requirements.

Responsibilities include preparing and reviewing tax calculations, monitoring VAT transactions, maintaining tax records, and ensuring the accurate preparation of tax returns and related documentation. Professionals will assist with VAT registration, tax reconciliations, invoice verification, tax reporting, and the assessment of applicable tax treatments for business transactions. Additional duties include monitoring changes in tax legislation, identifying potential compliance risks, supporting tax audits, reviewing financial records, and coordinating with finance and accounting teams to resolve tax-related discrepancies. They will also contribute to improving tax procedures, maintaining supporting documentation, and ensuring that tax processes remain accurate, transparent, and compliant with relevant regulatory standards.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of taxation principles, VAT regulations, and tax compliance procedures.
Knowledge of tax reporting, VAT calculations, reconciliations, and financial documentation.
Ability to interpret tax legislation and assess its implications for business transactions.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial or accounting software.
Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in handling financial information.
Understanding of tax audits, regulatory reporting, and compliance documentation.
Strong communication, organizational, and coordination skills.
High professional integrity and the ability to maintain confidential financial information.
